```{r}
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(here)

# 1. Setup paths
input_dir  <- here("Data", "raw", "EEG", "hypnograms_xls")
output_dir <- here("Data", "processed", "EEG", "unblinded_hypnograms")

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# 2. Load Blinding Key
blinding_key <- read_excel(here("Data", "raw", "EEG", "blinding_files", "blinding.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(ParticipantID = as.numeric(ParticipantID))

# 3. Get file list
blinded_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)

# 4. Multi-sheet processing loop
unblind_log <- lapply(blinded_files, function(file_path) {
  
  # Extract the ID number from the start of the filename (e.g., "130")
  file_id <- as.numeric(str_extract(basename(file_path), "^\\d+"))
  
  # Find the corresponding unblinded name
  match_row <- blinding_key %>% filter(ParticipantID == file_id)
  
  if (nrow(match_row) == 0) {
    message(paste("Warning: No match found for ID:", file_id))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Define the new filename
  new_name <- paste0(match_row$Original_filename, ".xlsx")
  dest_path <- file.path(output_dir, new_name)
  
  # --- THE MULTI-SHEET LOGIC ---
  # 1. Identify all sheets in the current blinded file
  s_names <- excel_sheets(file_path)
  
  # 2. Read every sheet into a list
  all_sheets_list <- lapply(s_names, function(s) {
    read_excel(file_path, sheet = s)
  })
  
  # 3. Assign names to the list (so writexl makes tabs with these names)
  names(all_sheets_list) <- s_names
  
  # 4. Export the whole list as a multi-tab Excel file
  write_xlsx(all_sheets_list, dest_path)
  # -----------------------------
  
  return(data.frame(Old_ID = file_id, New_Name = new_name))
})

# 5. Review results
final_log <- bind_rows(unblind_log)
cat("\n--- Unblinding Complete (All Sheets Preserved) ---\n")
cat("Total files processed:", nrow(final_log), "\n")
```
